/bin/zsh -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
from html.parser import HTMLParser
import re
p=Path('index.html')
s=p.read_text()
class Check(HTMLParser):
 def __init__(self): super().__init__(); self.ids=[]; self.scripts=[]; self.refs=[]
 def handle_starttag(self,tag,attrs):
  a=dict(attrs)
  if 'id' in a:self.ids.append(a['id'])
  if tag=='script' and a.get('src'):self.scripts.append(a['src'])
  if tag=='img':self.refs.append(a.get('src'))
c=Check();c.feed(s)
print('HTML bytes:',p.stat().st_size)
print('Duplicate IDs:',[x for x in set(c.ids) if c.ids.count(x)>1])
print('Remote scripts/images:',c.scripts,c.refs)
print('Root files:',[x.name for x in Path('.').iterdir() if x.is_file()])
js=re.search(r'<script>(.*?)</script>',s,re.S).group(1)
Path('/private/tmp/kestrel-script.js').write_text(js)
PY
node --check /private/tmp/kestrel-script.js"
